# Cao Yu (Cinematographer)

Cao Yu (曹郁) is a Chinese cinematographer known for his work in both Chinese and international film productions. Here is what I know about him:

## Career Highlights

Cao Yu is regarded as one of China's most accomplished and sought-after cinematographers. He has worked with several prominent directors in the Chinese film industry.

Some of his notable works include:

- **"Kekexili: Mountain Patrol"** (2004) — Directed by Lu Chuan, this film about Tibetan antelope poachers gained international attention and showcased Cao Yu's ability to capture stark, beautiful landscapes. The film won awards at various international festivals.
- **"City of Life and Death"** (南京！南京！, 2009) — Also directed by Lu Chuan, this black-and-white film about the Nanjing Massacre was widely praised for its striking cinematography.
- **"Monster Hunt"** (捉妖记, 2015) — A major box office hit in China.
- **"Legend of the Demon Cat"** (妖猫传, 2017) — Directed by Chen Kaige.

## Personal Life

He is known to be married to Chinese actress **Yao Chen** (姚晨), one of China's most popular and well-known actresses.

## Recognition

He has received nominations and awards at Chinese film ceremonies, including the Golden Rooster Awards and others, for his cinematographic work.

I should note that my information may not be fully comprehensive or up to date, and he should not be confused with the famous Chinese playwright Cao Yu (曹禺), who is a completely different historical figure.
